system.description:
Leaden clouds rush to the sorcerer’s call; thick, stinging rain sweeps the fields, causing his enemies to despair. This incantation causes a torrential downpour that turns the earth to soupy mud, drowns out the cries of men and washes out bridges and homes. 1 over: light rain; 2 over: rain; 3 over: heavy rain; 4 over: downpour with accompanying, minor flash floods; 5 over: storm squall with flooding and minor damage to buildings; 6 over: storm and serious flooding, cows float away; 7 over: heavy storm with damage to wooden buildings; 8 over: flooding and sudden downpour causes buildings to collapse. Weapon Length: as Missile; Range: as Heavy Crossbow +2D.

Obstacle: 4^. Actions: 256.

Origin: Sight | Area of Effect: 100s of Paces | Element: Water/Air | Impetus: Control | Duration: Instantaneous | Resource Points: 16

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 218
